sections.content: Images make pages heavy — optimize them: right format (WebP/AVIF today, JPEG photos, PNG transparency, SVG graphics), correct dimensions, and lazy loading below the fold.
Always set width and height attributes (or CSS aspect-ratio) to prevent layout shift, and write meaningful alt text — decorative images get alt="".
Key points: srcset serves different sizes to different screens, <picture> enables art direction, and never link directly to huge originals.
